title: Crash using the clipboard functionality
body:
### Tested versions

first seen in v4.3.1.rc [b51be503c]

not encountered in 4.3.stable

### System information

Fedora 41 - Godot v4.3.1.rc [b51be503c] - Vulkan (Forward+) - dedicated AMD RX 7900XT

### Issue description

issue:
 invocation of the clipboard under wayland causes a crash.

expected outcome:
selected items and/or buttons that add items to the clipboard add those items to the clip board

